scripts.start:electron: nodemon --watch src/main --watch src/shared --watch src/main.ts --watch src/preload.ts --ext ts,js --delay 2 --exec "cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron dist/main.js"
scripts.start: node -e "if(process.platform==='win32')require('child_process').execSync('chcp 65001')" && npm run ensure:playtime-helper && npm run build:preload && npm run build:main && concurrently -k "npm run start:main" "vite" "npm run start:electron"
scripts.build: npm run ensure:playtime-helper && npm run build:preload && npm run build:main && npm run ensure:installer-shell && npm run copy:assets && npm run build:vite && npm run verify:deps && electron-builder --win && npm run organize:build-output
scripts.build:fast: npm run ensure:playtime-helper && npm run build:preload && npm run build:main && npm run ensure:installer-shell:fast && npm run copy:assets && npm run build:vite && npm run verify:deps && set CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false&& electron-builder --win --config.win.signtoolOptions.sign=./scripts/noop-windows-sign.js && npm run organize:build-output
scripts.build:linux: npm run ensure:playtime-helper && npm run build:preload && npm run build:main && npm run copy:assets && npm run build:vite && npm run verify:deps && set CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false&& electron-builder --linux && npm run organize:build-output
scripts.build:all: npm run ensure:playtime-helper && npm run build:preload && npm run build:main && npm run ensure:installer-shell && npm run copy:assets && npm run build:vite && npm run verify:deps && set CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false&& electron-builder --win --linux && npm run organize:build-output
scripts.build:dir: npm run ensure:playtime-helper && npm run build:preload && npm run build:main && npm run copy:assets && npm run build:vite && npm run verify:deps && set CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false&& electron-builder --win --dir && npm run organize:build-output
scripts.test: npm run build:main && npm run test:vitest && npm run test:node
